comment: Approved coverage exceptions. An entry without proof is a failure.

exceptions.reason: ScalarizeIf scalarOrEltWiderThan(0,64) is shadowed by the ClampScalar narrow rule X86_IMPLICIT_DEF#8, whose scalarWiderThan(0, sMaxScalar) guard is a strict superset (the bound is 64 on a 64-bit target and 32 on i386).
exceptions.proof: core.json X86_IMPLICIT_DEF#8 NarrowScalar guard is bitsOf(0) > sMaxScalar, i.e. >64 on x86_64 and >32 on i386; literal rule 19 predicate is bitsOf(0) > 64. Every type that satisfies 19 also satisfies 8's guard, so the exhaustive C0-C3 first-match search finds no query whose first match is 19.

exceptions.reason: ClampMinNumElements<0, X86_s64, 2> guard requires a fixed vector of s64 with fewer than 2 elements, which LLT cannot represent.
exceptions.proof: Generated guard is isFixedVector && element==s64 && numElements<2; LLT::fixed_vector requires at least 2 lanes, so exhaustive C0-C3 domain search finds no trigger.
